citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
The facility could not provide records demonstrating the submission of their 2025-2026 semiannual IACUC reports to the
Institutional Official (IO). These reports must be forwarded to the IO so that they may verify the facility's compliance with
the Animal Welfare Act. The facility must prepare reports of its evaluations conducted as required by paragraphs (c)(1)
and (c)(2) of this section, and submit the reports to the Institutional Official of the research facility.
Correct by August 28, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the registrant.
